name: brainrouter-benchmark
description: Clean BrainRouter benchmark suite split into Memory and CLI tracks.

scripts.bench:memory:dry-run: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js memory:dry-run
scripts.bench:memory:retrieval: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js memory:retrieval
scripts.bench:memory:load: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js memory:load
scripts.bench:memory:all: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js memory:all
scripts.bench:cli:dry-run: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js cli:dry-run
scripts.bench:cli:deterministic: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js cli:deterministic
scripts.bench:cli:live: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js cli:live
scripts.bench:datasets:list: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js datasets:list
scripts.bench:datasets:import-membench: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js datasets:import-membench
scripts.bench:datasets:build-split: npm run build --silent && node --max-old-space-size=8192 dist/index.js datasets:build-split
scripts.bench:datasets:build-longmemeval: npm run build --silent && node --max-old-space-size=8192 dist/index.js datasets:build-longmemeval
scripts.bench:datasets:build-locomo: npm run build --silent && node --max-old-space-size=8192 dist/index.js datasets:build-locomo
scripts.bench:report: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js report
scripts.bench:cli:behavior: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js cli:behavior
